title: Assumption
description: Governed cryptographic assumption, pinned to an exact Lean declaration in `formal-core` (`security/assumptions/<id>.json`).

lean_decl.description: Fully qualified Lean name of the hypothesis *definition* (a `Prop`-valued def in formal-core), e.g. `Arena.Assumptions.Sha256CollisionResistant`.

lean_decl_digest.description: Digest of the Lean declaration's exported type+value (filled by the governance tooling; checked by the formal checker).
